steps.title: Customer downloads plain-text receipt for own order
steps.explanation: New GET /orders/:id/receipt route returns 404 for orders not owned by the caller, otherwise sends renderReceipt output as text/plain. Check the ownership lookup via findOrder and the 404 path.

steps.title: Builds receipt text and caches it in memory for one hour
steps.explanation: Formats item lines and total from cents, storing results in an unbounded module-level Map with a hard-coded 1-hour TTL. Check the cache has no eviction, is keyed only by order id, and ignores the new config setting.

steps.title: Config changes: receipt settings, cache TTL, and rate limit
steps.explanation: Adds receipts.currency and footer and cache.ttlSeconds.receipts, which the code does not read. Also raises rateLimit.perMinute from 60 to 600, which is unrelated to the feature and needs confirmation.
